name: CartNexo – Abandoned Cart Recovery
author: Yeasin

sections.description:
Did you know that over 70% of store carts are abandoned? Stop letting customers ghost you!

The CartNexo – Abandoned Cart Recovery plugin helps you recover lost revenue by seamlessly capturing customer phone numbers while they type on your checkout page.

Built by Yeasin, this plugin features a modern dashboard right inside your WordPress admin area.

Free Features:

  • Silent Capture Technology: Captures the customer’s phone number, name, and cart contents the moment they click away from the phone input field.
  • Bypass Caching Issues: Custom JS session handling ensures captures work perfectly even if you use page caching plugins.
  • Modern Dashboard: Track your “Recovered Revenue,” pending carts, and conversion rates in a stunning UI.
  • One-Click Recovery: Adds a “Send Message” button next to abandoned orders.
  • Custom Message Templates: Write your own recovery message using dynamic tags like {name}, {total}, and {items}.

Pro Features (Available via yeasinwp.com):

Upgrade to the Ultimate Edition to put your sales recovery on autopilot!

  • 🤖 100% Background Automation: Connects to messaging APIs to send recovery texts automatically while you sleep.
  • 🎫 Dynamic Discount Codes: Automatically generates auto-expiring coupons (e.g., 10% off) and injects them into the message.
  • ⏱️ Custom Timing: Send messages exactly 15 mins, 1 hour, or 2 hours after abandonment.
  • 💬 Storefront Chat Widget: Enable a beautiful floating chat button so customers can reach you instantly.
  • 📥 CSV Export: Download your leads for ad retargeting.
  • 📜 Full API Logging: See the exact delivery status of every automated message.
sections.installation:
1. Ensure your eCommerce store plugin is installed and activated.
  2. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  3. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  4. Navigate to CartNexo in your dashboard to configure your message template.
sections.faq:
Does this work with block checkouts?

Yes! Our custom capture script uses event delegation to work perfectly with both classic checkouts and modern block checkouts.

Will this slow down my checkout page?

No. The capture happens asynchronously in the background using lightweight AJAX requests. It has zero impact on checkout speed.

Do I need a paid API to use the free version?

No! The free version uses standard browser links, which open your computer or phone’s native chat application to send the message for free.
